In Connect Image, players are challenged to complete fragmented pictures by matching pieces to their corresponding shaded outlines. The objective is simple but engaging: arrange various parts of an image onto the shaded areas, gradually revealing the full picture as you progress. Each puzzle features distinct sections that need to be carefully connected, testing both your visual perception and problem-solving skills. As you place the image parts in the right spots, the incomplete image slowly transforms into a complete and vivid picture, offering a satisfying sense of accomplishment. The difficulty increases with each level, introducing more complex images and intricate pieces, providing a fun and rewarding experience for players of all skill levels. Whether youre looking to relax or challenge your mind, Connect Image offers an addictive puzzle experience that will keep you hooked for hours!

Instructions

Deep Space is a simple cliker game that aims to be easy and comfortable to play. Grow your platoon by stacking cash and buying new ships, so you can stack more cash and buy even better ships! The game has only one mode, you can just start playing right away. Clickers items multiply your output damage, which in turn will earn you more cash. Ships are generators and as soon as you buy them, you start earning. You can exchange your current stack (currency, ships, clickers) for a global multiplier (prestige) that will reset the game but will help you upgrade faster.

Instructions

Mouse click or tap to play
